claims.text: Second- or third-degree AV block w Sx or hemodynamic compromise and ↓likelihood of coronary ischemia: β-adrenergic agonists (isoproterenol, DA, dobutamine, Epi) may be considered to improve AV conduction, ↑ventricular rate and improve Sx.
claims.quote: For patients with second-degree or third-degree atrioventricular block associated with symptoms or hemodynamic compromise and who have low likelihood for coronary ischemia, beta-adrenergic agonists, such as isoproterenol, dopamine, dobutamine, or epinephrine, may be considered to improve atrioventricular conduction, increase ventricular rate, and improve symptoms.
